answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like a jade seal pressed into a contract: the stake is slashed when peers prove fake attestations, so one operator running a thousand sock-puppets must fund a thousand bonds. Honest agents earn the stake back with fees, while a saffron-flagged identity that misbehaves loses its bond and must climb the ridge again from zero reputation, making Sybil farming cost more than it pays.
